title: Flight Risk
description:
Fight Risk is a minimalistic desk job game where you play as an air traffic controller trying to save a rogue flight. Master the communication systems before it's too late, or just wing it and see what happens!

This is a SHORT game about deciphering systems and interactions. You will fail many times before you succeed.Features:• ~20-45 minutes of gameplay; depending on the player

• Mixed 3D and text-based graphics

• Retro 1980s aesthetic

• Master air traffic computers

• Translate flight codes

• Navigate difficult terrains

• Keep your pilot safe
